# atproto Provider

Manage AT Protocol records, including Tangled knots, repositories, and profiles.

Every record is written to the repository of the account the provider logs in as.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "atproto" {
  handle = "alice.bsky.social"
  # Prefer the ATPROTO_APP_PASSWORD environment variable.
  app_password = var.app_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_password` (String, Sensitive) App password for the account. May also be set with the `ATPROTO_APP_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `handle` (String) Handle or DID of the account. May also be set with the `ATPROTO_HANDLE` environment variable.
- `pds_host` (String) URL of the account's PDS, such as `https://bsky.social`. Defaults to the PDS in the account's DID document. May also be set with the `ATPROTO_PDS_HOST` environment variable.
